name: augengine
description: AugEngine: a web-native runtime for persistent, memory-bearing, guard-railed AI characters inside deterministic game state, drivable by agents over MCP.
author: Jeremiah Omiagbo (Blackpig Films LLC)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mnemopay/augengine-lod -w @mnemopay/augengine-detective -w @mnemopay/augengine && npm run build -w @mnemopay/augengine-mcp -w augengine-detective-game
